# Sent with every page by hosts that read this file (Cloudflare Pages does).
# Written by tools/build.mjs from tools/headers.txt. Do not edit _headers by hand.
# The first line is the same rule the page carries inside itself, plus a ban on showing the
# site inside a frame on another site. The others tell the browser not to guess file types,
# not to pass on where a visitor came from and not to offer camera, microphone or location.
/*
  Content-Security-Policy: {{policy}}; frame-ancestors 'none'
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  X-Frame-Options: DENY
  Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
  Permissions-Policy: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=()
  Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
